explainer.title: What arrives and when
explainer.hint: Notifications are about one thing only: marking a registration as done. An organizer sets the deadline and the reminders for each hackathon; you cannot add your own.

REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.name: Registration required
REGISTRATION_REQUIRED.when: Once, soon after an organizer assigns you to a hackathon that has an open registration. It carries the link and the deadline.

REGISTRATION_REMINDER.name: Reminder before the deadline
REGISTRATION_REMINDER.when: At each interval the organizer set before the deadline — for example a day before. There may be several, or none at all.

REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.name: The deadline has passed
REGISTRATION_OVERDUE.when: After the deadline, if the organizer set such a reminder. It stops once the hackathon ends.

explainer.stopTitle: Mark yourself registered and the reminders stop
explainer.stopHint: Reminders go only to people whose registration is still unmarked. Open the hackathon and press "I registered". You set it yourself — the system does not check the external site. Nothing else switches them off for one hackathon.
explainer.timingNote: Sending is checked every few minutes, so a notification can arrive slightly after the moment it was due. A message may also arrive twice: delivery guarantees at least one attempt, not exactly one.

card.title: Notification channel
card.hint: If the selected channel is unavailable, the system falls back in the order Telegram → Email.
card.setUpInAccount: Channels are set up in the Account section, together with the email address and Telegram.

preview.title: Notification preview
preview.subtitle: The text this recipient would receive. Nothing is sent, queued or logged by opening this.
preview.noSideEffects: Preview only: no notification is created and no rule is switched on.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.channelNotReadyHint: This recipient has neither a linked Telegram account nor a verified email, so this notification would end as undeliverable.
preview.nothingHint: This status has no notification to render: the event, the registration or the assignment rules it out.

matrix.title: Event and channel
matrix.hint: Which channel each reminder of this event would go to. One notification uses one channel: the override if set, otherwise the recipient preference, otherwise Telegram then Email.
matrix.inAppTitle: In the app is a mirror, not a channel
matrix.inAppHint: Everything sent is also shown in the app. It is never chosen instead of Telegram or Email, it does not take part in the channel choice and it cannot make a notification undeliverable.
matrix.emptyHint: Add a rule to see which channel it would use.
